name: ADB over Wi-Fi
summary: Lets a computer on the car's Wi-Fi control the head unit
description: Adds a switch to Tweaks for ADB over the car's Wi-Fi, kept in step with Engineering Mode's ADB switch. Warning: there is no password, so anyone on the car's Wi-Fi can control the head unit. Needs Tweaks.
author: hazptr

versions.notes: First release. Replaces the TCP ADB package.
